Formal Sink Set T — Morales-Pastor et al. 2025 Nat Commun
DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-60003-0 | PMID 40500255 | PMC PMC12159191

SOURCE NOTE:
- MOESM2 (41467_2025_60003_MOESM2_ESM.pdf) = "Description of Additional Supplementary Files" only
  (lists Supplementary Data 1–4). It does NOT contain the intracellular sink residue list.
- Formal definition recovered from article Methods (Dijkstra / LigACN path termini), PMC full text
  (PMC12159191, paragraph describing 100 shortest pathways / sinks).

DEFINITION (from Methods):
Taking the resulting networks from the WT simulations, Dijkstra's algorithm (NetworkX) was used
to calculate the 100 shortest pathways connecting the ligand CHEMBL5085420 (source) and four
selected residues in the intracellular domain of the receptor (sinks) for each replica
(100 pathways × 4 sinks × 5 replicas = 2000 pathways).

SINK SET T (four residues; Ballesteros–Weinstein numbering in parentheses as published):
1. Arg131 (3×50)   — R131^3.50
2. Asp240 (6×30)   — D240^6.30
3. Ser303 (8×47)   — S303^8.47
4. Ser69  (2×39)   — S69^2.39

Selection criterion (paper): proximity to the G protein in the CB2R–G protein complex
(Supplementary Fig. 12 in SI / MOESM1).

STATUS: EXTRACTED (primary Methods text). MOESM2 recovered but is inventory-only.
